The following events took place in '''43 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] embarked on an investigation into the history of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Falcon" />
*The [[Unification Summit]] was held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Outcast" />
*[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was charged with dereliction of duty by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] and Coruscant.<ref name="Outcast" />
*[[Kenth Hamner]] became acting Jedi Grand Master of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Outcast" />
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] was [[Mission to save Kessel|saved from destruction]] after it was discovered that the planet had been rigged to explode.<ref name="Outcast" />
*[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Seff Hellin]], [[Valin Horn]],<ref name="Outcast" /> [[Jysella Horn]], [[Natua Wan]],<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> [[Bazel Warv]], and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] were possessed with an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]].<ref name="Abyss" />
*Jedi Knight Valin Horn was put on [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|trial]] and [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Outcast" />
*Seff Hellin was [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|captured]] by [[Darkmeld]].<ref name="Outcast" />
*Luke Skywalker and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] found the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] and Luke came into contact with the [[Codex]], a [[Relics|relic]] which magnified his presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Omen" />
*The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] Skywalker's presence and was alerted to the danger he presented to them, and [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] abruptly left Kesh after spending [[41 ABY|two years]] there helping the Tribe form a new [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]].<ref name="Omen" />
*The Lost Tribe sent a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] to hunt down Ship and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Omen" />
*Luke and Ben Skywalker discovered the [[Mind Walkers]] at [[Sinkhole Station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].<ref name="Abyss" />
*Hellin, Wan, Warv, and Saav'etu were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] from Coruscant to [[Shedu Maad]] to escape prosecution by the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Abyss" />
*The Skywalkers were [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attacked]] at Sinkhole Station by the Lost Tribe of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team.<ref name="Abyss" />
*[[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] fled to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], pursued by the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]], and organized a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]]-Sith alliance.<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
*Chief of State Natasi Daala hired [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|invade]] the [[New Jedi Temple]], in order to force the Jedi to submit to direct Galactic Alliance control.<ref name="Backlash" />
*[[Broken Columns Clan]] and [[Raining Leaves Clan]] merged into [[Bright Sun Clan]].<ref name="Backlash" />
